column1: # Border outlines for build-region-fast.sh (--clip-poly), one per region id.
# A region listed here is built cut to its outline, widened by 10 km, instead
# of its registry bbox (cloud/regions.tsv); zoom 0-10 still covers the whole
# box as greyed context. ops/region-outline.py fetches the outline and cuts it
# to the box; unlisted regions build by the box as before.
# Variants (cloud/region-variants.tsv) use their parent's row. Europe adds Armenia and
# Azerbaijan, which Geofabrik files under Asia (the site lists them in Europe).
# European regions (2026-10-12). Each row names the countries in the site's
# description (web/generate.py); the box cuts them, so a big neighbour that
# the description includes in part (Ukraine's "western Russian frontier")
# is listed whole. Unlisted on purpose: switzerland ("and the surrounding
# Alps", and its Light variant): its box is all land in the countries it
# would list, so a cut would change nothing.
# The September regions outside Europe and the US (2026-10-13: "Redo them
# with all the new fixes - boundary based"), by the same rule. Additions
# beyond the description's list: caucasus lists Russia and Turkey whole
# (its description includes parts of both), west-africa adds Guinea-Bissau
# (it would be a hole between Senegal and Guinea), west-asia adds Cyprus
# (an island inside the box, on the September map), pacific-islands adds
# Nauru, Tuvalu and Kiribati (inside the box and on the September map; the
# box cuts Kiribati at 180). Japan's outline comes from Geofabrik's index
